content.short: PixelPals is a pixel-art NFT game on Mantle where players collect, raise, and battle digital companions with unique traits and abilities.
content.description: PixelPals is a pixel-art style blockchain game on Mantle where players collect, nurture, and battle digital companions represented as NFTs. Each PixelPal has unique pixel-art aesthetics and in-game attributes that determine its combat effectiveness and rarity value. Players can earn rewards by winning battles, completing quests, and participating in tournaments. The game features a player-driven economy where rare companions and items trade on secondary markets, giving player achievements tangible economic value.
